0022600097.text: The Wizards (1-0, 2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East) host the Toronto Raptors (1-0, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) in a matchup where both teams have won their only game so far this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Washington lost 1-2 to Toronto in the 2025-26 season series, including a 134-125 Raptors win in Washington on February 28, 2026. Out for Washington are AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), while Felix Okpara is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision; Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot).
